exceptions.justification: Transitive via github-actionlint, used only to lint this repository's own committed .github/workflows/*.yml during npm run contract -- never extracts an untrusted archive; adm-zip's actual vulnerable code path (zip extraction) is never exercised.
exceptions.alternatives: No fix available at any adm-zip version; github-actionlint itself has no alternative extraction-free release.
exceptions.remediation: None available; revisit if github-actionlint drops or replaces its adm-zip dependency.
